title: Data Serialization: JSON, YAML, and CSV
instructions: Answer from the lesson. For short-answer and practical items, equivalent technically correct wording/code earns credit.

questions.prompt: What does successful JSON parsing guarantee?

options.text: The data satisfies every business rule
The file is safe to trust

questions.explanation: Parsing checks grammar; schema and domain validation are separate.

questions.prompt: Why should general CSV data not be parsed with `line.split(",")`?

options.text: Quoted fields may contain commas and escaping rules

questions.explanation: CSV parsers handle quoting, embedded delimiters, and newline rules.

questions.prompt: Explain the difference between parsing and validation.
questions.expected_answer: Both stages are needed for reliable input handling.

questions.prompt: Why use `with open(..., encoding="utf-8")` when reading JSON?
Name a safe way to load untrusted YAML in PyYAML and one further check.
questions.expected_answer: Safe loading reduces unsafe object construction, but domain validation is still required.
